Hollywood action films get judged on box office and explosions. VirtueVigil judges them on something the industry pretends does not exist: values content. Every film in our database is scored on both a Woke Score and a Traditional Score using the same methodology across every review. The rankings below are sorted by net traditional margin, meaning the gap between traditional content and progressive ideology. The bigger the gap, the cleaner the film scores on values.

These ten action films from 2024 topped the field. Some are franchise blockbusters. One is a Japanese anime theatrical release. All of them earned their ranking through actual story content, not perception or cultural reputation. Here is where the 2024 action genre really stood when you run the numbers.

  • 1

    Solo Leveling: ReAwakening (2024)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +27 TRAD

    The highest net traditional score of any action film released in 2024, and it is not close. This theatrical compilation of the Solo Leveling anime series follows Sung Jin-Woo, a hunter who rises from the weakest rank to become the most powerful fighter alive through discipline, sacrifice, and a refusal to quit. VirtueVigil flagged meritocracy as the supreme value, self-improvement through suffering as the heroic arc, and a complete absence of progressive ideology throughout. Woke score: 1.26. Trad score: 28.35. Net margin: +27.09 traditional. A near-perfect values score for an action film.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 2

    The Beekeeper (2024)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +21 TRAD

    Jason Statham plays a retired government operative who discovers his elderly landlady was scammed out of her life savings by a politically connected fraud operation. What follows is a one-man war carried out with precision and zero tolerance for injustice. VirtueVigil flagged vigilante protection of the vulnerable, stoic masculine competence, elder care as a sacred obligation, and villains who receive real consequences. Woke score: 4.25. Trad score: 25.48. Net margin: +21.23. The second-highest traditional margin in 2024 action.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 3

    Transformers One (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +16 TRAD

    The animated origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron is the best Transformers film in decades, and it got there by taking the friendship between those two characters seriously as a moral tragedy. The film earns its traditional score through sacred male friendship depicted without irony, heroic self-sacrifice as the defining test of character, clear distinctions between good and evil, and hard work as the only path to earned excellence. Woke score: 2. Trad score: 18.48. Net margin: +16.48. Franchise filmmaking that respects the source material and its audience.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 4

    Gladiator II (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +16 TRAD

    Ridley Scott returned to Rome and built a sequel around personal honor, martial virtue, and what it costs a man to betray his own values. Paul Mescal carries the film as Lucius, and Denzel Washington commands the screen as the opportunistic Macrinus. VirtueVigil flagged personal honor as the supreme value, institutional corruption as the true villain, and the classical framework of duty, sacrifice, and earned glory throughout. Woke score: 7. Trad score: 22.84. Net margin: +15.84. A confident sequel that trusts the tradition it came from.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 5

    Twisters (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +15 TRAD

    Lee Isaac Chung directed one of the rare modern blockbusters built for the whole country instead of just the coasts. Glen Powell plays a cowboy storm chaser whose heroism is rooted in competence and courage, not politics. Heartland communities are shown with genuine dignity, and the film avoids climate change moralizing entirely, focusing instead on human courage against natural forces. Woke score: 10.08. Trad score: 24.64. Net margin: +14.56. The feel-good crowd-pleaser of the 2024 action calendar.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 6

    Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +14 TRAD

    The internet spent months labeling this film woke. The VirtueVigil data disagrees. Anya Taylor-Joy plays a woman kidnapped from her home as a child who spends the entire film fighting to return, driven by family loyalty and survival instinct rather than ideological identity. George Miller earns the traditional score through home and family as the ultimate motivation, a protagonist who earns every victory through suffering and discipline, and male villains who face genuine consequences. Woke score: 8. Trad score: 22. Net margin: +14. Judge it on the numbers.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 7

    Road House (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +14 TRAD

    Nobody expected the Road House remake to work, let alone score as a masculinity-affirming values film. Jake Gyllenhaal plays Dalton, a former UFC fighter who takes a bouncer job at a Florida Keys bar and ends up defending an entire community against organized crime. VirtueVigil flagged masculine competence as the heroic core, community defense as the central moral obligation, consequence culture with villains who actually get punished, and redemption through service rather than therapy. Woke score: 4. Trad score: 18. Net margin: +14. Exactly what the genre used to deliver as a matter of course.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 8

    Sonic the Hedgehog 3 (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +14 TRAD

    The best installment in the Sonic franchise gets darker without losing its values foundation. Keanu Reeves voices Shadow the Hedgehog in a storyline centered on grief, government overreach, and the path to redemption through truth rather than power. VirtueVigil flagged chosen family earned through loyalty and sacrifice, grief treated with real emotional dignity, self-sacrifice as the highest moral expression, and government overreach positioned as the antagonist force. Woke score: 4.2. Trad score: 18.34. Net margin: +14.14. Safe for families. Worth watching for everyone else.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 9

    Rebel Ridge (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +10 TRAD

    Jeremy Saulnier's Netflix action thriller follows Terry Richmond, a Marine veteran who arrives in a small Louisiana town to post bail for his cousin and discovers a local police force engaged in systematic civil asset forfeiture and corruption. Aaron Pierre carries the film with controlled intensity. VirtueVigil flagged institutional accountability as the central value, veteran competence and discipline as the heroic foundation, rule of law restored through individual courage, and government corruption punished without ideological framing. Woke score: 8.18. Trad score: 18.5. Net margin: +10.32. A lean, efficient thriller with real values underneath.

    Read the VirtueVigil review
  • 10

    Venom: The Last Dance (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +14 TRAD

    Tom Hardy closes out his three-film commitment to this character in a finale that understands exactly what it is. The Eddie and Venom dynamic remains one of the most oddly charming pairings in franchise history, and the film builds toward a conclusion that earns its emotional weight through loyalty and sacrifice rather than spectacle alone. VirtueVigil flagged loyalty as the ultimate virtue, sacrifice for others as the highest moral act, redemption of a former adversary, and individual courage over institutional cowardice throughout. Woke score: 3.5. Trad score: 17.07. Net margin: +13.57. A clean close to a franchise that consistently avoided the lecture.

    Read the VirtueVigil review

The Best Action Films of 2024 on Values

Every film on this list earned its ranking through actual story content. No reputation bonus, no genre exception, no ideological benefit of the doubt. Solo Leveling leads by a wide margin because it treats meritocracy and self-improvement as the literal point of the story, not as props. The Beekeeper follows because it treats elder protection and masculine accountability as real obligations, not character quirks. The rest of the list reflects 2024 action output that understood the deal: give the audience a hero worth following, consequences worth believing, and a story that respects the values of its viewers.

Not every film here is perfect on the woke side. Twisters carries a moderate woke score. Furiosa carries one too. But the traditional content in those films is real and substantial, and the net margin is what the ranking reflects. That is the VirtueVigil methodology: honest accounting on both sides of the ledger, no selective scoring, no agenda in either direction.
